facts.claim: LIS26 session page: 'Who let the agent in?', 12 Nov, SaaS Summit, Stage 7, names Feedzai as the speaker's organisation
LIS26 attendee page: Diogo Guerra, CTO, Feedzai; country and industry as listed by Web Summit; public bio
what the company does, from its own site (title and description)

Co-founded by Nuno Sebastião (Co-Founder, Chairman and CEO) and Pedro Bizarro, Ph.D. (Co-Founder and Chief Science Officer), as Feedzai's own Leadership page lists them; the founders came from the European Space Agency, by its About page.

On 2 October 2025 Feedzai announced a $2 billion valuation after an investment round of about $75 million (new investors Lince Capital, Iberis Capital and Explorer Investments; renewed backing from Oxy Capital and Buenavista Equity Partners), the same day the ECB named it first-ranked tenderer for the digital euro's central fraud detection. Its own release states no funding stage.
